checks.label: TEE Implementation
checks.command: (gk=$(getprop ro.hardware.gatekeeper 2>/dev/null); ks=$(getprop ro.hardware.keystore 2>/dev/null); wv=$(getprop ro.hardware.weaver 2>/dev/null); sb=$(pm list features 2>/dev/null | grep -i strongbox); km=$(service list 2>/dev/null | grep -iE 'keymint|keymaster' | head -1); out=''; [ -n "$wv" ] && out="weaver=$wv "; [ -n "$sb" ] && out="${out}strongbox=present "; [ -n "$km" ] && out="${out}keymint_or_keymaster=present "; [ -n "$gk" ] && [ "$gk" != 'default' ] && [ "$gk" != 'software' ] && out="${out}gatekeeper=$gk "; [ -n "$ks" ] && [ "$ks" != 'default' ] && [ "$ks" != 'software' ] && out="${out}keystore=$ks "; echo ${out:-NOT_FOUND})
checks.description: PCI-DSS: TEE/hardware-backed key storage required for payment operations. Checks gatekeeper, keystore, weaver props + StrongBox feature + KeyMint/Keymaster service. Outputs detected signals or NOT_FOUND. Skips 'default'/'software' (pure SW fallback).
checks.remediation: Replace device with one that has a hardware-backed TEE or enable StrongBox/KeyMint in the vendor firmware.

checks.label: Secure Element HAL
checks.description: Secure Element HAL libraries for hardware security module access
checks.remediation: Install the vendor-provided Secure Element HAL or verify the device supports hardware SE.

checks.label: Keymaster HAL Version
checks.description: Keymaster HAL version - higher versions have better security features
checks.remediation: Update vendor firmware to the latest Keymaster/KeyMint HAL version available for this device.

checks.label: Kiosk Mode (Lock Task)
checks.command: result=$(dumpsys activity 2>/dev/null | grep -iE 'mLockTaskModeState|mLockTaskMode[^S]' | grep -oE '[0-9]+' | head -1); echo "${result:-0}"
checks.description: POS should run in kiosk/lock task mode (1=locked, 2=pinned). Supports both old (mLockTaskModeState) and new (mLockTaskMode) Android property names. Returns 0 if not in kiosk mode.
checks.remediation: Configure the POS app as a device owner and enable lock task mode via DevicePolicyManager.setLockTaskPackages().

checks.label: App Pinning Enabled
checks.description: App pinning should be enabled for single-app POS kiosk mode
checks.remediation: Enable app pinning via Settings > Security > App pinning, or set lock_to_app_enabled to 1 using device policy.

checks.label: Payment Apps Installed
checks.description: Count of payment-related applications installed
checks.remediation: Audit installed payment apps and remove any unauthorized or unused ones to reduce attack surface.

checks.label: Payment App Permissions
checks.command: for pkg in $(pm list packages 2>/dev/null | grep -iE 'pay|wallet|pos|terminal' | cut -d: -f2 | head -3); do dumpsys package $pkg 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'permission.*INTERNET|permission.*NFC|permission.*CAMERA' | head -5; done
checks.description: Review critical permissions granted to payment apps - INTERNET+NFC+CAMERA combo needs manual review
checks.remediation: Revoke unnecessary permissions from payment apps, especially CAMERA if not required for barcode scanning.

checks.label: Dangerous Permission - CAMERA
checks.command: pm list packages 2>/dev/null | cut -d: -f2 | while read pkg; do dumpsys package "$pkg" 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'android.permission.CAMERA.*granted=true' && echo "$pkg"; done | grep -ivE 'camera|photo|scan|barcode|qr' | head -5
checks.description: Non-camera apps with CAMERA permission - potential card skimming risk
checks.remediation: Revoke CAMERA permission from flagged apps via adb shell pm revoke <package> android.permission.CAMERA.

checks.label: Open Listening Ports
checks.command: netstat -tlnp 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'LISTEN' | awk '{print $4}' | grep -oE '[0-9]+$' | sort -u | tr '\n' ',' | sed 's/,$//'
checks.description: Lists listening TCP ports on the device. SAFE if no ports are listening (typical for a locked-down POS terminal). Any port produces an INFO entry in the report with the port list so the auditor can review whether the listed ports are expected. This is the inverse of the previous behaviour (v5.7.0 and earlier flagged 'no ports' as INFO and 'ports listed' as SAFE, which was the wrong direction for a POS audit).
checks.remediation: Close unnecessary listening ports and disable services not required for POS operation.

checks.label: Remote Desktop Ports
checks.description: PCI-DSS 2.2.7: RDP(:3389)/VNC(:5900-5901,:5800)/SSH(:22)/ADB-net(:5555) must be closed. :4444 included as Metasploit/reverse-shell indicator - verify manually if flagged.
checks.remediation: Disable remote access services (RDP, VNC, SSH, ADB over network) and block these ports via firewall rules.

checks.label: Suspicious Processes - Memory Tools
checks.command: ps -A -o cmd 2>/dev/null | grep -iE '\bmemdump\b|\bmemscrap\b|\btcpdump\b|\bstrace\b|\bltrace\b' | grep -ivE 'dumpstate|dumpsys|dumpcrash|tombstoned|incidentd' | grep -v grep
checks.description: Memory dumping tools detected - potential RAM scraping malware indicator
checks.remediation: Kill the flagged process immediately, investigate its origin, and remove the binary from the device.

checks.label: Suspicious Processes - Known POS Malware
checks.description: Known POS malware process names detected
checks.remediation: Isolate the device from the network immediately, perform forensic analysis, and reimage with verified firmware.

checks.label: Hotspot Disabled
checks.description: PCI-DSS: WiFi hotspot must be disabled on POS terminals
checks.remediation: Disable WiFi hotspot via settings put global wifi_ap_enabled 0 and enforce it through device policy.

checks.label: Clipboard Manager Apps
checks.description: Third-party clipboard apps may capture card data
checks.remediation: Uninstall third-party clipboard manager apps and restrict app installs via device policy.

checks.label: POS Vendor Properties
checks.description: POS vendor-specific system properties detected
checks.remediation: Verify vendor properties match the expected POS hardware and firmware version for this deployment.

checks.label: Log Files with Card Patterns
checks.description: PCI-DSS 3.4: Files potentially containing standalone PANs (Visa/MC/Amex/Discover). Uses digit-boundary matching to reduce false positives from serial numbers and IDs.
checks.remediation: Delete or securely wipe files containing PAN data. Ensure the application encrypts or tokenizes card numbers.

checks.label: Debug Log Level
checks.description: Verbose logging may expose sensitive payment data in logs
checks.remediation: Clear the debug log tag via setprop persist.log.tag "" and restart logging to use default log levels.

checks.label: Logcat Buffer Size
checks.description: Large log buffers may retain sensitive transaction data longer
checks.remediation: Reset log buffer to default size via setprop persist.logd.size "" to limit retention of sensitive data.

checks.label: PAN Data in SQLite Databases
checks.description: PCI-DSS 3.4: SQLite databases containing unencrypted PAN card data. Uses sqlite3 .dump (text output) instead of raw strings to avoid binary false positives.
checks.remediation: Purge unencrypted PAN data from flagged databases. Use tokenization or encryption for stored card numbers.

checks.label: Screen Recording Process Active
checks.description: Screen recording tool detected - may capture card data or PIN entry on POS terminal
checks.remediation: Kill the screen recording process and uninstall the app. Enable FLAG_SECURE on payment activity windows.

checks.label: NFC Relay Attack Tools
checks.description: NFC relay attack tool detected - intercepts and relays contactless payment data in real-time
checks.remediation: Kill the NFC relay process, uninstall the app, and verify NFC service integrity with the vendor firmware.

checks.label: PAX Terminal Services
checks.description: PAX terminal-specific processes detected - verify all services are legitimate PAX firmware
checks.remediation: Cross-check running PAX processes against the official PAX firmware manifest for this device model.

checks.label: PAX Unsigned Partition Access (CVE-2023-42134)
checks.description: PAX unsigned partition block device accessible - CVE-2023-42134 allows local code execution via unsigned partition flashing
checks.remediation: Apply the PAX firmware update that patches CVE-2023-42134 and restricts access to partition block devices.
